name: post_stress_cet1_ratio
question_template: Use exact arithmetic. A bank's common equity tier 1 capital is K={K} USD million and its risk-weighted assets are R={R} USD million. A stress scenario produces a one-off loss of L={L} USD million that reduces capital in full while risk-weighted assets are unchanged. Compute the post-stress CET1 ratio as a percentage of risk-weighted assets without intermediate rounding, then round only the final value half up to 2 decimal places.

slots.description: Exact capital remaining after the stress loss.
